t: This is Lady Margaret School in Parsons Green, Fulham, an all-girls' Church of England secondary school. It became an academy in 2012 and celebrated its hundredth anniversary in 2017, with a service at Westminster Abbey. Princess Alexandra is its patron, and opened the assembly hall in 1965. The school was founded by Charles Frederic Moberly Bell, a journalist who was managing director of The Times, where he founded the forerunners of the Times Literary Supplement and the Times Educational Supplement.
